title: Verify Sales Representative cannot access Vendors or vendor sensitive fields
preconds: Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Sales Representative role. (this role has Vendor & Order Management = Off, so vendor sensitive fields are unreachable regardless of the Manage AP/AR gate introduced in spec v33).
steps:
1. Look at the main navigation for a Vendors entry.
2. If a Vendors entry exists, try to open it.
expected: Vendors is not reachable for Sales Representative, so vendor sensitive fields (Credit Terms, Credit Limit, Taxes) can never be displayed to this role.
